title: Report a taxi
summary: You can report an unsatisfactory experience when booking or travelling by taxi.
intro:

faqs.q: How can I report an issue with a taxi?
faqs.a: You should provide feedback through the Taxi fare complaints form.

faqs.q: What information should I include when making a report?
faqs.a: You should include as much information about the experience as possible.

faqs.q: Who can I talk to about my report?
faqs.a: You can phone the Point to Point Transport Commission Industry Contact Centre on 131 727.
